svg.title: Why the reparameterization trick lets gradients through
svg.desc: Left: sampling z directly from N(0.3, 0.7788 squared) gives z = 0.1442, but the gradient dL/dz = 2.0 stops at the random sampler. Right: z = mu + sigma epsilon with mu 0.3, s -0.5, sigma 0.7788, epsilon -0.2 gives the same z = 0.1442, and the gradient reaches mu (2.0) and s (-0.1558).
svg.text: The encoder never receives a gradient,
so μ and s never learn.
ε gets no gradient and needs none.
